description: The AI Platform for Go-To-Market (GTM). Power your GTM on 1eye, an AI platform that orchestrates go-to-market strategy and execution through intelligent data and agentic workflows.

Adonis provides AI-driven revenue cycle management solutions for healthcare organizations, offering automated billing, denial prevention, and actionable insights to optimize claim processing and improve cash flow efficiency. The platform integrates with existing systems to reduce administrative burdens and enhance revenue outcomes.

Aera is a financial services platform designed to help first-time home buyers in New Zealand overcome deposit hurdles by offering high-interest savings products, deposit credits, and personalized support throughout the home-buying process. Through its app, users can manage spending accounts, pay bills, and accelerate their savings to secure a home with as little as a 2.5% deposit.

Aerodome is an innovative startup that provides an end-to-end automated drone response system for police and fire departments. After an agency receives an emergency call, a drone arrives on the scene within 3 minutes and steams video in real-time to responding personnel. This allows authorities to better assess the situation and respond accordingly, be it deploying officers, the fire department, or other emergency services.

Agree is a new payments platform built on top of e-signature. Imagine if docusign and bill.com were a fully-integrated experience while providing AI summaries in plain language for document sections, enabling users to understand content easily, ask specific questions about the document and assist the accounts receivable department.

Ariglad uses AI to automatically update and create knowledge base articles by analyzing customer support tickets, release notes, and other sources. It identifies knowledge gaps, merges duplicates, and ensures content stays up-to-date, reducing support tickets and improving customer self-service.
Ascend Arc provides bandwidth as a service from proprietary geo stationary satellite hardware.

Asset Reality provides a comprehensive platform for managing the seizure, tracking, and liquidation of both physical and virtual assets. Their solution integrates with custodial, blockchain analytics, and valuation services to ensure secure handling, transparent reporting, and maximized returns for victims.

Aster is an all-in-one patient management platform designed for women’s health clinics, streamlining care delivery with features like remote patient monitoring and holistic support for providers and patients.

Attend provides innovative ticketing solutions designed to attract and engage younger audiences for live entertainment events. Their platform offers a variety of ticketing options, including subscription passes and last-minute deals, tailored to meet the needs of venues, leagues, and brands looking to grow their fan base and revenue.

Auditive is an AI-driven marketplace that simplifies third-party risk management by automating security reviews for businesses and their vendors. This innovative platform enhances efficiency and security in vendor relationships.

August offers a customizable subscription service for period care products, including pads, tampons, and liners, made from sustainable and non-toxic materials. The company emphasizes comfort, affordability, and environmental consciousness while also supporting menstrual equity by donating products with every purchase.

Autana is a digital platform for custom manufacturing that helps OEMs in North America get their industrial components produced and delivered with precision, using software to control the entire process. Specializing in services like die-casting, CNC machining, and injection molding, Autana provides a full supply chain solution with transparency and efficiency.

Axis Pay is a financial platform that enables small businesses to manage payroll, contractor payments, and employee reimbursements through a mobile wallet. It offers features such as instant salary payments, salary advances, and cashback rewards, all while ensuring secure transactions and same-day onboarding.

Axo Longevity is a preventive health and longevity company that offers an annual membership providing over 100 biomarker blood tests, follow-up panels, and personalized insights from clinicians to track and optimize long-term health. By combining data-driven diagnostics with ongoing monitoring and tailored recommendations, Axo helps individuals detect early signs of imbalance and proactively improve their healthspan. ‍

Besolo is a technology-driven Professional Employer Organization (PEO) platform that simplifies compliance and administrative tasks for high-earning self-employed individuals, or "solos," by providing access to corporate-level benefits and a full suite of back-office tools.

Betterleave is an integrative grief support platform that provides personalized, tech-enabled care for families and caregivers throughout all phases of bereavement, from advance care planning to post-loss milestones. It combines clinical mental health expertise with platform analytics to deliver high-quality, cost-effective support for individuals and organizations.
Beyond Will is a personalized digital assistant that provides step-by-step guidance for organizing and updating estate plans, helping users manage their legal and financial affairs efficiently.
Big Leap Health is a digital health platform connecting patients with in-network clinics offering innovative treatments for depression and anxiety, including TMS, Spravato, and Ketamine therapies.

Biotia provides genomics-based diagnostic tools and platforms that enhance the detection and characterization of pathogens. Their products leverage metagenomics and AI to improve the accuracy of infectious disease diagnostics, predict outbreaks, and support global health monitoring efforts.

Bitewing AI is building a claims-native AI “revenue OS” for dental practices that analyzes contracts, claims, and payer routing to detect underpayments, optimize PPO strategy, and automate recovery workflows. The platform aims to recover lost revenue and improve cash flow across dental groups, starting with PPO optimization and expanding into a broader revenue-cycle and fintech layer.

Blakthumb offers a comprehensive seed-to-sale ERP platform designed for the cannabis industry, streamlining operations across cultivation, production, and inventory management. The platform integrates tools for compliance, forecasting, and real-time inventory tracking, enabling businesses to enhance efficiency, maintain regulatory standards, and optimize sales performance across multiple sites.

Bonside provides growth capital to brick-and-mortar businesses through a unique financing model called Repeatable Revenue Agreements (RRAs), allowing businesses to access non-equity capital in exchange for a percentage of their revenue until a fixed cap is reached. This model helps businesses expand without giving up ownership or taking on traditional debt, while offering investors a new way to earn returns from stable, growing businesses.

Booky is a food discovery and delivery platform that allows users to browse and order from over 31,000 restaurants at exclusive prices. It offers a seamless experience for finding and enjoying meals, with no need for separate driver bookings, making it easy to satisfy cravings with direct delivery.

Boom provides a platform that helps property managers streamline operations by offering automated rent reporting to credit bureaus, tenant screening, and secure data management. It enables renters to build their credit by reporting on-time rent payments to all three major credit bureaus.

Boomerang is an automated platform that helps HR teams quickly fill roles by reconnecting with qualified candidates from their existing talent pool, streamlining the hiring process and reducing recruitment costs.

Boost is a B2B commerce platform that helps manufacturers and distributors in Africa's convenience economy digitize their operations. It offers tools for effortless WhatsApp ordering, data-light apps for fulfillment and payments, and real-time analytics, while also providing stock financing to support growth across diverse markets.

bops.ai is an AI-driven platform that enhances inventory management for consumer brands by streamlining Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment (CPFR). It integrates with existing retail systems to synchronize supply chain data with consumer demand, helping reduce stockouts, excess inventory, and markdowns through dynamic planning, real-time insights, and proactive recommendations.
Bright Harbor is a disaster response concierge that helps people rebuild and navigate the aftermath of extreme weather and natural disasters.

Brooklyn Health provides comprehensive, community-based care management services for Medicaid patients, connecting them with dedicated care managers and a network of physical and behavioral health providers, social services, and community programs.

Burro develops autonomous, collaborative robots designed to assist with labor-intensive tasks in agriculture and other industries. Their robots use advanced machine learning, GPS, and sensor technology to autonomously transport, tow, and navigate both indoor and outdoor environments, helping to offset the need for human labor and enhance productivity.
Caba Design creates and manages a portfolio of consumer brands, focusing on product development, sourcing, and supply chain logistics to bring innovative products to market.
Camu provides banking and compliance software tailored for Latin American startups, streamlining financial operations and ensuring regulatory adherence across the region.

Candosa provides an all-in-one platform that simplifies the process of forming and managing UK-based companies, offering services such as company incorporation, compliance management, and virtual office solutions, all designed to help freelancers and entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses with ease.
Cascade provides a comprehensive debt collection platform that helps businesses recover outstanding debts through data-driven strategies, advanced analytics, and tailored recovery solutions.
Century Health accelerates drug development and commercialization by applying cutting edge LLMs to messy longitudinal clinical data.

Ceres Technology offers an AI-powered platform that predicts multi-tier supply chain risks leveraging 25,000+ real-time datasets to help businesses anticipate delays and disruptions months in advance.
Chaiz is an online marketplace that allows users to compare and buy car extended warranties from top providers, offering significant savings and direct online purchasing.

ChargerHelp provides operations and maintenance services for electric vehicle (EV) charging stations, ensuring high uptime and reliability. The company leverages technology and workforce development to keep EV chargers functional, minimizing downtime for both personal and fleet charging networks.

Ciphero is an AI Verification Layer that allows enterprises to control & verify all AI interactions within the workspace by monitoring and managing models (including 3rd party models such as ChatGPT) to be secured & compliant to the company's requirements and policies. We prevent any aspects of data loss of proprietary/confidential information, and ensure it remains at the company.

Circle is an AI-powered platform that connects benefit providers, health companies, and communities by integrating systems, workflows, and data to optimize member experiences. It offers tools for identifying new markets, tracking customer life cycles, and uncovering revenue opportunities through data analytics and machine learning.
CISGAM is building a microfluidic electrospray propulsion system that serves as an integrated mobility layer for autonomous, highly maneuverable small satellites.

Clean Cult offers eco-friendly cleaning products designed to reduce plastic waste through a refillable system. Their powerful, non-toxic formulas are available in recyclable, paper-based refills and reusable bottles, aiming to create a sustainable and effective cleaning solution for homes.

Cofertility is a human-first fertility ecosystem rewriting the egg freezing and egg donation experience. With their Freeze by Co platform, women can freeze their eggs for free when they donate half of the retrieved eggs to a family who can’t otherwise conceive.

Compliable provides a platform that automates the employee licensing process, enabling businesses to efficiently manage multi-jurisdictional licensing, reduce form errors, and streamline renewals through a secure, centralized interface.

Complyance is a comprehensive compliance management platform that offers automation, AI, and no-code configuration to support the management of standard frameworks, helping companies achieve and monitor compliance.

WeConceive is an online platform that provides evidence-based fertility and pregnancy advice, as well as personalized support and community for those trying to conceive. The website offers a range of membership options, including access to expert-led coaching, a supportive community of peers, and a comprehensive curriculum to guide users through their fertility journey.

Contra is a commission-free platform that connects freelancers with clients, enabling seamless project management, contract creation, and payment processing. It allows independent professionals to showcase their work, find opportunities, and manage their business operations while keeping 100% of their earnings.

CoverTree provides specialized insurance solutions for manufactured homes, offering customizable policies that protect homeowners from a variety of risks, including property damage and liability. Their platform simplifies the process of obtaining affordable coverage tailored to the unique needs of manufactured home owners.

Cube is a financial planning and analysis (FP&A) platform that streamlines budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes by integrating real-time data and eliminating manual consolidation, enabling teams to make data-driven decisions quickly and efficiently.

Curios is a creator-centric platform that enables artists and content producers to publish, distribute, and monetize their work directly to fans, offering encrypted content delivery, ticketing, and comprehensive audience engagement tools.

Cybera provides a scam reporting and asset recovery platform that integrates advanced anti-money laundering (AML) intelligence to help organizations prevent and respond to internet crimes. Their solutions include AI-driven fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and victim support, aimed at reducing cybercrime-related costs and recovering lost funds in both crypto and fiat currencies.

Dapple Security offers a passwordless authentication platform powered by advanced biometrics, designed to protect both individual privacy and identity through a privacy-by-design approach. Their technology eliminates the need for traditional passwords, enhancing security while prioritizing user control and data protection.

Devo offers an integrated PoS system for convenience stores, enabling seamless management of in-store and online orders, real-time inventory updates, and easy restocking from wholesalers. It also provides a delivery platform for local stores to offer direct-to-door service.

Dollaride provides clean transportation solutions to underserved communities by equipping local drivers and fleet operators with technology, financing, and infrastructure to manage and grow their services. The company also supports the transition to electric vehicles through its Clean Transit Access Program (CTAP), offering a comprehensive path to electrification for small fleets.

Domeo AI provides an accounts receivable automation platform designed for mid-market finance teams, unifying invoice and payment data to streamline deductions, collections, payments, and cash application processes for suppliers working with large buyers

Donna is an AI-powered sales assistant that automates administrative tasks for sales teams, including CRM updates and drafting follow-up emails. It helps streamline workflows by reducing post-meeting admin time, ensuring accurate data capture, and enabling sales reps to focus more on closing deals.

Dorothy is redefining disaster recovery by providing a tech-driven platform that simplifies the insurance claim process and connects disaster victims with recovery advocates. Leveraging proprietary data, the platform ensures fair compensation for property owners affected by denied, disputed, or underpaid claims, streamlining the path to recovery.
DoWhatWorks is a data-driven platform that helps companies optimize their marketing spend by identifying and focusing on the most effective channels and strategies for their specific business needs.

Ecotone Renewables develops sustainable solutions for food waste management using their anaerobic digestion system, ZEUS, which converts food waste into renewable energy and nutrient-rich organic fertilizer, Soil Sauce.

EdSights uses AI-powered SMS communication and chatbots to help higher education institutions improve student retention by providing real-time insights, personalized support, and data-driven interventions based on student feedback. The platform enables universities to engage students effectively and monitor their persistence through tools like the Student Voice Score (SVS), offering actionable insights to enhance the student experience.
Efficient Capital Labs provides capital in a fast, seamless & cost-effective manner to SaaS Businesses. They offer non-dilutive capital to help grow businesses, with funds available within 3 days.

Electric AI is an all-in-one IT management platform designed for small to medium-sized businesses, offering automated solutions for device provisioning, security, employee onboarding/offboarding, and app management. It provides tools to protect against cyber threats, streamline IT operations, and integrate with HR systems to boost productivity without requiring extensive technical expertise.

The Electric Plant Company is leveraging the intelligence of the plants by translating its electrical signals into actionable insights, aiming to transform plant and tree care today and accelerate a techno-biophilic future by unlocking this vast, untapped data stream. ￼

Elektra Health provides a comprehensive menopause care platform offering telemedicine consultations with board-certified clinicians, evidence-based educational resources, 1:1 personalized support, and access to a private community. The service aims to empower women by addressing menopause symptoms through expert care, ongoing support, and community engagement.

EngFlow provides a remote build execution and caching platform that accelerates software builds and tests by distributing tasks across multiple machines. It integrates with popular build systems like Bazel, Goma, and Soong to improve developer productivity and reduce build times significantly.
Eudia provides AI-driven solutions tailored for legal departments, enhancing efficiency and security through advanced automation and data analysis tools.

Eve Vehicles provides an autonomous Drone First Responder network, delivering real-time critical information to public safety professionals. Their system uses advanced drones and a command center to enhance emergency response efficiency, reduce costs, and save lives by providing early intelligence to first responders within minutes of an incident.

Everlab offers a preventative health service that combines advanced diagnostics, continuous monitoring, and personalized care to detect diseases early, improve wellbeing, and optimize long-term health performance. By leveraging AI and medical data, the platform creates individualized health protocols that track biomarkers and suggest interventions to prevent chronic diseases and enhance longevity

Figuro is a digital insurance agency offering property and casualty (P&C) insurance solutions across Latin America, providing a seamless online experience for customers to compare, purchase, and manage their insurance policies.

Finalis provides a comprehensive, compliance-driven platform that streamlines workflows for dealmakers, enabling them to focus on closing deals while ensuring regulatory adherence and maximizing access to private capital markets.

Fishwife offers ethically sourced, premium tinned seafood, celebrating sustainability and quality while revitalizing the traditional canned fish experience. Their products are crafted to be enjoyed on their own or as part of diverse culinary creations

Flickplay is a gamified content creation platform that allows users to engage with digital collectibles and immersive experiences tied to real-world pop culture locations. It enhances user interaction through location-based challenges and rewards.

Flora is the first individually-owned insurance solution for fertility and women's health, offering affordable coverage for future fertility treatments including egg freezing, IUI, and IVF. The company aims to help women plan, predict, and pay for their future fertility on their own terms and timeline, while also providing a community platform with added value through perks, knowledge, and support.

Flossy offers a tech-enabled dental insurance platform that connects individuals with pre-screened dentists, providing affordable care, annual rewards, and a seamless experience through modern technology.

Flow Medical develops innovative catheter-directed thrombolysis technology for the treatment of pulmonary embolism, aiming to optimize clot dissolution while minimizing complications, such as bleeding or long-term pulmonary hypertension.

Flume Internet provides high-speed gigabit fiber optic internet services, delivering reliable and fast broadband to residential and enterprise customers. Their fiber-based infrastructure ensures superior performance compared to traditional connections.

Flux Payroll develops foundational payroll infrastructure for global markets, offering payroll calculation APIs, tax filing and registration services, and no-code SaaS products that enable payroll companies, accountants, and banks to deliver modern payroll solutions to their clients. Their platform accelerates localization and compliance in underserved regions through AI-driven ingestion of legal and tax documentation, making it faster and easier to launch and operate payroll software internationally

Flychain provides a comprehensive financial platform for healthcare providers, combining specialized bookkeeping, consolidated financial reporting, and tailored tools for capital access, treasury management, valuation, and revenue cycle optimization. Its solution simplifies complex financial workflows across multi-entity practices while addressing industry-specific challenges like regulatory demands and intricate billing cycles.

FORA is an AI-powered ERM platform designed for the C-suite. The company provides a smarter approach to solving organizational challenges and cultivating richer relationships, identifying and anticipating potential challenges before they become business problems.

Forem is an open-source platform that enables the creation of independent, modern, and safe online communities, facilitating deep and nuanced discussions. It powers customizable public or private forums for various interest groups.
Forerunner Flood provides property-level flood risk data to help streamline floodplain management, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve community outreach efforts.

Foundation Technology provides an end-to-end digital platform for homebuilders that enhances the buyer and ownership experience. It streamlines the homebuyer journey from contract to close with automated updates and milestone tracking, while offering homeowners tools to manage their new homes post-purchase, including warranty requests and documentation access.
FusePay is a mobile money app aimed at transforming payment solutions in underserved African islands by significantly reducing transaction fees and enabling real-time settlements.

GDevelop is a no-code, open-source game development platform that allows users to create and publish games quickly and easily using an intuitive event-based system, without needing programming skills. It offers a range of built-in behaviors, templates, and extensions to streamline game creation for both beginners and experienced developers.

Gentreo provides a comprehensive, digital estate planning platform that allows users to create, manage, and store essential legal documents such as Wills, Trusts, and Powers of Attorney, all while offering secure access and regular updates to ensure plans stay current. The service simplifies estate planning for individuals and families by offering an affordable and accessible solution online.

Getro provides an automated job board and private talent network platform that helps organizations efficiently connect people with job opportunities by leveraging AI-driven matchmaking and real-time updates.

GovWorx analyzes data captured in 911 call Audio, Voice Radio Audio, and CAD Body Camera video and helps automate evaluation and coaching, similar to what Gong currently does for sales teams. It helps first responders improve and saves hours of admin work.

Grapefruit Health connects healthcare organizations with trained clinical students to engage hard-to-reach patients, reducing staffing shortages and improving patient outcomes through a tech-enabled workforce. Their platform handles student recruitment, training, and patient matching, enhancing care teams' efficiency while lowering costs.

Ground is an AI-powered platform that helps companies unlock untapped revenue by leveraging customer, product, and site data to boost sales from both new and existing customers, particularly through email and SMS channels. It automates revenue growth by identifying opportunities for repeat purchases and converting invisible site visitors into paying customers.

Guaranteed is a tech-enabled hospice platform that partners with payors and providers to deliver value-based care for seriously ill patients, using analytics and a high-touch care team to ensure timely transitions to end-of-life care. The platform customizes hospice recommendations based on patient needs, cultural preferences, and continuous prognostication.

Halfdays offers stylish, high-performance ski wear and outdoor apparel designed specifically for women, focusing on comfort, fit, and functionality without the pressures of traditional outdoor culture. Their product line includes lightweight outerwear, base layers, and accessories that seamlessly blend style with technical performance for outdoor adventures.

Handl Health provides advanced data analytics solutions that empower benefits consultants to optimize healthcare networks, design effective plans, and drive cost savings by leveraging publicly available pricing data and proprietary AI models.

Hark provides a solution for customer support ticket management. They offer tailored workflows to collect the right information for every scenario, streamlining the support ticket management process. Their AI-powered sentiment analysis provides valuable insights to help improve the support experience.
Headroom is a platform that streamlines business operations by providing tools designed to enhance productivity and efficiency, helping companies future-proof their workflows.

Headway is a platform that connects individuals with mental health providers who accept their insurance, streamlining the process of finding, booking, and paying for therapy or psychiatric care. It removes administrative burdens by handling all payment and billing logistics, making mental health care more accessible and affordable.

Health Data Atlas develops and provides a proprietary healthcare market intelligence platform that delivers accurate, up-to-date organizational hierarchies and provider profiles, enabling users to analyze provider relationships, enrich existing data, and make informed strategic decisions quickly and efficiently. Their solution leverages AI, claims data, and expert researchers to offer actionable insights for a wide range of healthcare industry use cases, including market analysis, provider search, and network optimization

Hiro Science has developed a novel delivery system for Peptides (including GLP-1) and other small molecule compounds via Transdermal Microneedle Patches capable of delivering multiple doses from a single patch with a bioequivalent delivery profile to a subcutaneous shot. A true 1:1 replacement for needle-based interventions.

HIVED provides sustainable parcel delivery services using a 100% electric fleet, offering same-day, next-day, and two-day delivery options. Their technology-driven platform ensures reliable, emission-free deliveries while enhancing customer experience with live tracking and instant support.

Hound is a recruitment and retention platform designed for the veterinary industry, offering tools for team recognition, rewards, feedback, and community building while facilitating connections between relief professionals and employers. It provides modern solutions to improve workplace satisfaction and streamline hiring processes, with free access for relief professionals.
